compatibility.sameMajor: compatible when newer minor changes are additive
compatibility.majorMismatch: reject agent stream and fall back to ADB/Desktop capabilities
compatibility.removedOrRenamedFields: not allowed inside the same major
compatibility.semanticChange: requires a new field or a new protocol major

roles.desktop: Welltech Desktop/Mobile Center: UI, ADB, Fastboot, firmware, scrcpy, orchestration, fallback and reports
roles.agent: Welltech Mobile Agent APK: authorized Android APIs, structured telemetry and permission/capability reporting

phase1.name: adb-forward-http-websocket
phase1.hostPort: dynamic/free port chosen by Desktop per device
phase1.wifiTransport: not part of protocol 1.0; if added later it requires authenticated encryption/TLS

multiDevice.rule: one ADB forward + one session token + one stream per physical device
multiDevice.identity: sessionId/installId; never rely on IMEI as protocol identity

pairingAndSession.health: GET /api/v1/health may be unauthenticated but must expose only service/protocol/readiness/session-state metadata, never token, pairing code or device telemetry

healthFields.readyForPairing: true only while the technician-approved pairing window is open
healthFields.pairingRemainingSeconds: remaining pairing-window duration; zero when not waiting for a code
healthFields.paired: true after a valid code is accepted and until the session is revoked

pairing.precondition: agent UI has an explicit technician-approved pairing window open
pairing.proof: one-time pairing code or equivalent user-approved challenge

token.scope: single device + single active diagnostic session
token.expiry: session stop, agent stop, disconnect policy or explicit revoke
token.logging: must never be written to ordinary logs or reports

stream.reconnect: Desktop reconnects with the same session while token is valid, then requests a fresh snapshot
stream.queuePolicy: for high-rate telemetry keep latest state; never build an unbounded backlog
stream.sequence: monotonic seq per session; duplicate/older samples may be ignored

time.deviceElapsedRealtimeMs: monotonic device time for durations/order; preferred for media/session timing
time.rule: do not calculate precise durations by subtracting PC wall clock from Android wall clock

missingData.rule: never use magic/sentinel numbers as valid measurements; use null + explicit status/reason

units.currentMicroA: raw signed microamps when API exposes it; preserve source/sign semantics

privacy.mediaMetadata: do not persist title/channel/content unless technician explicitly attaches it to the service record
privacy.accountInference: forbidden; do not infer YouTube/Google active account
privacy.screenAndCamera: explicit scrcpy mode on Desktop; not automatic

safety.firmwareFlash: Desktop-controlled; APK is not a flashing engine
